title: Bounty: Document Appeal Fees and Staking
body:
This task requires documenting the appeal fees (20% bond) and worker staking (forfeited on claim expiry) introduced in ProofWorks Phase 9.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Create a new markdown file docs/bounty-rules.md.
2. Document that the appeal bond is 20% of the task reward.
3. Document that worker stake is forfeited if the claim expires without a proof submission.
4. References this issue in the PR body.
